# What each image is built from, as repo-root paths. docker.yml tags an image
# src-<hash of these paths' git trees>, and skips building it when the
# registry already holds that tag. A path an image COPYs but this
# file omits would let a change ship nowhere, so
# core/internal/buildguard/inputs_test.go fails on any Dockerfile COPY/ADD
# source not covered here. Each Dockerfile lives in its own directory, so the
# directory covers it. .dockerignore shapes every build context.
#
# component: path...
core: core dashboard islands proto/gen/go go.work.sum .dockerignore
provisioner: provisioner proto/gen/go go.work.sum .dockerignore
sidecar: sidecar proto/gen/go go.work.sum .dockerignore
executor: executor proto/gen/go go.work.sum .dockerignore
worker: worker .dockerignore
migration: migration db/migrations .dockerignore
